supabaseClassification: no write / environment none / SQL none / migration no

requiredRerunProofGates.realProductRouteBehavior: must exercise the product-facing route or equivalent server route harness rather than direct diagnostics
requiredRerunProofGates.approvedSnapshotGate: must reject missing or stale approved snapshot id/version before any tool call
requiredRerunProofGates.editPlanGate: must require structured edit-plan operation and use-case mapping
requiredRerunProofGates.creditGate: must require credit approval/reservation before any product tool call
requiredRerunProofGates.idempotencyGate: must require idempotency key and prove duplicate-safe behavior
requiredRerunProofGates.deterministicRankingGate: must prove ranked tool choice is stable for each approved use case
requiredRerunProofGates.workerDispatchGuardGate: must prove allowlisted worker dispatch only and block unsupported tools
requiredRerunProofGates.monitoringReceiptGate: must emit sanitized validate, queue, status, and blocker receipts
requiredRerunProofGates.rollbackGate: must prove global Track B and per-tool disable controls stop dispatch
requiredRerunProofGates.privacyGate: must prove no user/private media persistence, public artifact, signed URL, raw prompt, or private payload logging
requiredRerunProofGates.supabaseGcsNoWriteGate: must preserve no write / environment none / SQL none / migration no
requiredRerunProofGates.betaProductionGate: must keep external beta and production disabled until a later accepted QA gate

allowedInNextGate: bounded local/staging product route rerun harness
forbiddenUntilSeparatelyApproved: raw prompts or private payload logging
